# Delete all .pdf files from ~/downloads
access_token = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJmaWxlX3N5c3RlbStzdXNhbm1pbGxlckBnbWFpbC5jb20iLCJleHAiOjE2ODQ0MTIwOTh9.sBA8nTOBQAVmth-RrQqs0MVx8ZQw8WC82HGfNU7YU-g'
files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/downloads', entry_type='files', recursive=False)
pdf_files = [f for f in files if f.endswith('.pdf')]
print(f"Found {len(pdf_files)} PDF files to delete")
for pdf in pdf_files:
    result = apis.file_system.delete_file(file_path=pdf, access_token=access_token)
    print(f"Deleted {pdf}: {result}")
